name: React Hydration Contract Repair
summary: Repair hydration races by preserving identical server and first-client snapshots across theme, auth and data providers, then verify the actual browser condition.
problem: Arbitrary delays or suppressed warnings can hide provider state changes that make the first client render differ from server HTML, especially on mobile dark routes.
coreOutcomes: Stable initial React state and matching serialized data
Correct DOM versus React theme ownership
Browser evidence across themes, viewports and storage states
requirements: Exact server HTML and client source revision
Relevant provider initialization and external stores
Representative failing routes and browser observations
Repository-native build and browser acceptance checks
boundaries: A longer delay is not a hydration correctness guarantee
Do not suppress unexpected mismatch warnings as a repair
Hydrated UI is separate from downstream business acceptance
DOM ownership must be verified for the actual root
